title: The Use of Capsaicin Challenge for Diagnosis, Monitoring and Follow-up of Chronic Cough.
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether the capsaicin challenge can improve the diagnosis, treatment, monitoring and follow-up in patients with chronic cough.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with persisting cough for more than 3 months, without known respiratory or lung diseases

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of respiratory or lung diseases of any kind
